title: THE HEAVY HELMET LOSES ITS NEON BAR
why: Art build step (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The brief says to fix the neon green bar on the Heavy helmet that reads like a glitch. The crest was a tall bar in the raw scheme accent standing above the dome. It is now a low steel ridge, and the accent shows only as a small glowing lens with a glint on the brow.
now: The Heavy Helmet has a steel crest and a small glowing lens instead of a tall neon bar.
